title: Amana — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Amana.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Affordable Performance." Value tier. Amana is the value brand in the Whirlpool portfolio — reliable basics at the lowest price point. No fancy features, no WiFi, no apps. Just appliances that work. Amana is the go-to recommendation for rental properties, first apartments, and budget-conscious buyers who need a new appliance today without overthinking it.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Landlords, property managers, first-time renters, budget buyers who need a functional appliance at the lowest price.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Amana:

• Lowest price point from a major manufacturer — not off-brand, it is Whirlpool-made

• Simple controls — no apps, no WiFi, nothing to break or confuse

• Whirlpool Corporation quality and parts availability behind it

• Perfect for rentals — affordable to buy, cheap to repair, tenants cannot break what is not there

• Gets the job done without features nobody asked for
